bestObservedHoursUtc: 14:00 was positive in base and strict scenarios
21:00 and 22:00 were slightly positive or near flat
firstBacktest.symbolFinding: No symbol was profitable. ETH and BTC were least negative in some scenarios, but all tested symbols finished negative. ORDI, NEAR, AR, and TIA were consistently weak.

lastDecision: First 5m backtest failed badly. All scenarios were negative after fees/slippage, profit factor was far below 1.1, drawdown was unacceptable, and no symbol was profitable. Do not integrate Intraday Scalper 1D into Railway paper loop. Keep research-only and treat this version as rejected.

researchHypothesis.trendFilter: EMA20 > EMA50 for LONG and EMA20 < EMA50 for SHORT
researchHypothesis.entry: short pullback to EMA20 or VWAP followed by confirmation
researchHypothesis.volatilityFilter: ATR percent must be inside configured min/max range
riskControls: one open position per symbol in the research simulation

knownProblems: Intraday scalping edge disappeared after fees and slippage
Trade frequency was too high: 863 to 1761 trades on about 22 days of 5m candles
Win rate was only about 31.5% to 33.6%
Gross PnL was already negative before fees in all scenarios
Fees were very large relative to the 1000 USDT paper balance
Max drawdown was unacceptable: about 429 to 789 USDT
Worst recurring UTC hours were around 00:00, 05:00, 07:00, and 08:00
blockedChanges: Do not add Intraday Scalper 1D to Railway paper loop
Do not use OKX API keys
Do not use martingale or increase position size after losses
Do not relax filters only to create more trades if net edge is negative after fees/slippage
Do not reuse this exact 5m EMA20/50 pullback setup as a paper candidate

successCriteriaForFirstPass.drawdown: controlled and acceptable relative to 1000 USDT paper balance
successCriteriaForFirstPass.symbolDiversification: result should not come from one coin only
successCriteriaForFirstPass.paperLoopDecision: if edge disappears after fees/slippage, do not add to paper loop

nextResearch: Optionally test time-of-day filter using only UTC 14:00, 21:00, and 22:00, but only as research because sample may be weak
Optionally test long-only BTC/ETH/SOL subset and exclude ORDI/NEAR/TIA/AR from this scalper hypothesis
Reduce overtrading before any new backtest: lower maxTradesPerDay, increase cooldown, require stronger impulse/volume confirmation
Consider an opening-range or session-based intraday strategy instead of always-on EMA pullback scalping
Do not consider paper-loop integration unless a new variant shows positive gross PnL before fees and positive net PnL after fees/slippage
